settings.title: Domeček Janov
settings.description: The whole house for up to 17 guests, a large fenced garden and Bohemian Switzerland right outside the door.
settings.seoTitle: Domeček Janov | Whole holiday house in Bohemian Switzerland
settings.seoDescription: An entire holiday house for up to 17 guests, 6 bedrooms, a 4,000 m² fenced garden and a hot tub in Janov near Hřensko.
settings.heroTitle: The whole house, just for your group.
settings.heroDescription: Six bedrooms for up to 17 guests, 4,000 m² of fenced garden and a hot tub. The Hřensko gorges are two kilometres from the house.

accommodation.introTitle: One big house for three or four families.
introText: Domeček sits in a quiet part of Janov, a few minutes below Hřensko. It is always rented as a whole - six bedrooms, the large kitchen and dining room and the garden are yours alone.
Most of our guests are families with children, groups of friends, sports teams or small companies on a team-building trip. The house is open all year round.

garden.title: A spacious garden|all to yourselves.
garden.description: The terrace with the grill faces south. The garden has a trampoline, a swing and a playhouse - and because the whole plot is fenced, you can let the children out of sight and still have the hot tub to yourselves.
garden.cardText: A heated hot tub on the terrace. If you want it, we will have it ready for your whole stay.

trips.title: A different direction|every day.
trips.description: Janov sits on the edge of Bohemian Switzerland National Park, two kilometres from Hřensko. The gorges, rock viewpoints and the Pravčická brána arch are within walking distance or a few minutes by car.

pricing.title: The whole house.|No strangers.
